items: 【Acer 7-in-1 Wireless Charging station】30W Max Total Output,Fast Charging for iPhone, Apple Watch,AirPods (Note: Only compatible with wireless charging AirPods cases. Others can use the wired charging port).Dual Wireless Charging station + USB-C & USB-A Ports. Sleek Design for Home & Office Harmony (Note: For optimal wireless charging · please use cases under 2mm)

【Dual Wireless charger station for Two Phones】 Power up two devices Charging station. Effortlessly charge any combination of iPhones (including 16/15/14/13/12 Pro Max Series). This charging station features a built-in stand that securely holds your phone in landscape orientation—perfect for watching videos, taking calls, or following recipes hands-free. Note: This wireless charger is specifically designed for iPhone. To charge Android phones, you must use an additional magnetic compatible case.

【Smart LED Clock with Dual Time Setup】Experience effortless time management with Bluetooth-enabled automatic synchronization—simply connect to “S1” for instant wireless updates of time, weekday, and indoor temperature. For added convenience, manual controls on the back allow easy adjustment of clock and week settings. Customize your ambiance with adjustable warm or cool lighting, ideal for bedroom, office, or living spaces. ​​Note:​​ The LED display will not show indoor temperature while your phone is charging wirelessly.

【Thoughtful nighttime functionality】Both the LED display and night light feature 4 adjustable brightness levels, allowing you to set the perfect intensity for any situation. The night light offers three versatile modes: white, warm white, and warm yellow, adapting to your preferred ambiance. For easy control during sleep, simply use the two front buttons to adjust brightness or turn off the lights entirely. Plus, the built-in sensor automatically activates a soft, non-disruptive glow in low light, ensuring safe navigation in bedrooms, hallways, or any space—without disturbing your rest.

【Tangle-Free Nightstand Charger】This Apple wireless charger stand refreshes the space. Its compact design eliminates cable clutter and provides a neat and organized charging area, which is a big advantage for Apple users who prefer a tidy setup. As a gift, it's both practical and stylish. Whether it's for an Apple-loving friend or a family member with a neatly organized bedroom nightstand, it's the perfect phone charger choice!

【Safety for Multiple Devices Apple & 24-hour Support】The Acer wireless charging dock includes overcurrent, overvoltage, and temperature protection to ensure safe charging. Constructed from high-quality materials, Acer wireless charger features makes for a practical yet luxurious gift that shows you care about both style and safety. Plus, with a 18-month warranty and 24-hour customer service, you can buy with confidence. (Note: AirPods needs to be centered for charging).
